Pañcikā itself q. in Prakriyāsarvasva by Nārāyaṇabhaṭṭa in the beg. of 17th cent. he must be earlier than 1600 A. D.; the name shows that he belonged to Tamilnad (See Adyar Library Bulletin, IV. 2, p.. 74-75). Many of his works are mentioned in mss. a. Āṇḍvila--See Uttarāṇḍvila etc.
